activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1967 as Hendrix's representative American cultural milestone year. After establishing himself in Britain, he returned to the United States and his Monterey International Pop Festival performance made the Jimi Hendrix Experience a major American touring act.

sources.title: Jimi — The Official Jimi Hendrix Site
sources.citation_text: The official Jimi Hendrix biography records his June 1967 return to America and the Monterey International Pop Festival performance that rapidly established the Experience in the United States.
